test_title: PYST 13: SSC MTS 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question:
The bar graph shows the marks of a student in different subjects out of 100. His marks in physics is what percent more than that in mathematics?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ab31db133bac9cbd2b6ed0cc125143bc99bf23edc4d493def5c234de42efa78.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

The student got 54 - 40 = 14 marks more in Physics

So, the required percentage is,

⇒ (14 / 40) × 100 = 35 %

∴** The marks in physics is 35 % more than that in mathematics.**
